findings.message: Resolved from round 1: withBodyFile resolves the configured temporary base to a real absolute directory, creates its private directory there, and fchmods the open body descriptor to exact mode0600 before writing and syncing. Publish and merge regressions run under a relative TMPDIR, a coordinator cwd different from target.root, and umask0777; they inspect the absolute argv path and exact body/directory modes during the fake command, then prove cleanup after both success and provider rejection.

summary: T05R passes at frozen snapshot 7f2fb09ebbdf1f8818e5a114b14d42384b76047aac2a2a0d3979336475fd2a9d. The corrected adapter satisfies the absolute mode0600 temporary-body contract and retains exact remote/PR identity, bounded shell-free command execution, conservative checks classification, protected merge invocation, and post-merge remote-base proof. Coordinator npm test passed 144 tests and npm run validate passed at this exact snapshot. Recovery of a PR found already merged remains explicitly allocated to T05B and is not claimed here.
